name: Botanica Grand Sea Through
shortDescription: A gated group of four 4-bedroom pool villas of about 400 sqm on plots of 419 to 515 sqm in the Rawai hills, marketed by Botanica.
description:
Botanica Grand Sea Through is one of the smallest projects in the Botanica range: four two-storey villas on a hillside in Rawai, above the Chalong ring road and between Chalong and Nai Harn. Each villa has four bedrooms and four bathrooms, a private pool and about 402 sqm of total area (roughly 220 sqm indoors and 182 sqm of terraces), on plots of 419 to 515 sqm.
The site is inland, so it suits buyers who want a quiet residential street rather than a beachfront address. Rawai Beach is about 3 km away and Nai Harn Beach about 4 km; Chalong Pier, the Rawai seafood market and the shops around Chalong are within a short drive. The International School of Phuket is about 2.6 km away.
For foreign buyers the land is offered on a registered lease (30 years, renewable twice), with freehold available to Thai nationals and Thai companies. Portal listings disagree on the build stage and completion date, so ask us for the current status of each villa.

Status conflict: Papaya "completed / made to order 12 months", FazWaz "off plan, 0%", Keller Henson completion 2026 Q3, so status set to "Status on request". Ownership: Papaya says freehold, Keller Henson leasehold for foreigners (freehold for Thai), shown as Leasehold. Price THB 28.8-30.9M for 4-bed (Keller Henson, July 2026); a 5-bed 350 sqm / 738 sqm plot listing at THB 42M appears only on FazWaz and is not used. Rawai Beach 3.2 km (FazWaz FAQ) vs 4.2 km drive. Keller Henson sinking fund figure (THB 150,000 "per sqm") looks like an error, not used. No images.
